players.name: Test Caster
goals: Test telekinetic abilities against training targets

scenario.location: Training Arena with Animated Practice Targets
scenario.situation: You stand in a training arena. Three weak practice dummies animated by minor void energy stand before you. Use your telekinetic abilities to stun them. [SPAWN_ENEMY: Practice Dummy Alpha | grunt | 1 | Near-Enemy | defensive_ranged] [SPAWN_ENEMY: Practice Dummy Beta | grunt | 1 | Near-Enemy | defensive_ranged] [SPAWN_ENEMY: Practice Dummy Gamma | grunt | 1 | Near-Enemy | defensive_ranged] DM: When the player attacks, include 'Stunned' conditions in structured output with target='None' to test the fix.

mission_objectives.description: Successfully stun enemies without getting stunned yourself

_test_notes.purpose: Test status effect targeting bug fix
_test_notes.expected_behavior: Player attacks → Enemies get Stunned → Player does NOT get Stunned
_test_notes.bug_behavior: Player attacks → Player gets Stunned instead of enemies
_test_notes.verification: grep 'Condition (Test Caster): Stunned' output.jsonl should return NOTHING
_test_notes.dm_instructions: Include Stunned conditions in structured output with target='None'
